annotations.title: Upcoming fixtures for a club or a league

description: Form Guide. Upcoming fixtures for a club or a league. For requests like "who do Liverpool play next?" or "what's on in La Liga this weekend?". Without team or league, gives the Premier League.

country.description: US or CA adds US Eastern kick-off times to the say line (and to each fixture's us_eastern, which is always there when a time is known).

days.description: How far ahead, a whole number from 1 to 60. Default 21. If nothing falls in the window (an international break), the next fixtures are returned anyway.

league.description: One of: premier league, championship, la liga, bundesliga, serie a, ligue 1 (common variants like EPL or German Bundesliga work too). Any other league returns 404.

team.description: A club name, for example Liverpool or Real Madrid.
